title: bg3 harness event log, v1
description: One line of Sxxx.events.jsonl: a normalized client stream event (src client) or a runner event (src harness). Written by runner/events.py EventLog from runner/clients.py Event.to_json; fields at their default are left out. Token counts use input without cache reads.

seq.description: position in this file (one file per play process)

t.description: epoch seconds when the runner read the line or made the event

kind.description: client kinds: init, text, thinking, tool_call, tool_result, usage, rate_limit, compact, error, result. harness kinds: session_start, session_end, and the runner's events (fault, recovered, mcp_failed, ...)

tool.description: bare bg3 tool name; other servers' tools keep their prefix

api_error.description: an API, auth or usage-limit failure

tools.description: init: tools the model was given

cost_usd.description: result: the process's cost; null when the client can't know it

think_ms.description: thinking: the CLI's thinking time for the block

api_ms.description: result: API time of the process
